text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow is Valentine's Day. Since it's a 
special occasion, I decided to give Narita 
Taishin a present.
choice_data_list:
That said, Taishin isn't a fan of sweets, 
so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After picking out some biscuits coated in 
bitter chocolate, I headed home for the 
day.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? What's that?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh. ...Oh, today is...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Nah, well...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Exchanging friend chocolates and stuff... 
I don't really do that usually.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh, is that seriously for me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, I see.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Um... thanks.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And that night. While relaxing in my room—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hey. ...Are you there?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you haven't had dinner yet? ...Well, 
why not eat now?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, Narita Taishin had 
brought over a container packed with dry 
curry for me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since I hadn't eaten dinner yet and was 
quite hungry, I gratefully accepted the 
offer, but—
choice_data_list: (Why dry curry all of a sudden...?!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And what's more—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Why do you sound so surprised?
choice_data_list:
I didn't know you were such a good 
cook...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Not really... My family ran a business and 
my parents were busy, so I just took care 
of myself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's really not something to get 
so thrilled about, is it? It's just dry 
curry...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“It is neither a lie nor an exaggeration. 
It possesses a mellow sweetness and rich 
depth, to the point where one wonders if 
some special ingredient was used—”

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's better than being told it 
tastes awful, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well... I have a curfew, so.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin hurried off as if running 
away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The aftertaste of her dry curry lingered 
with a subtle, gentle sweetness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Between being so hungry and it tasting so 
good, before I knew it, I had completely 
cleaned my plate.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, you're welcome.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, after a sudden silence fell—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You said it before, didn't you? About 
"forever" and all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Until Narita Taishin, who can't believe in 
herself, learns to believe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if it takes a lifetime, I'll believe 
in her—come to think of it, that's what I 
told her.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Well, just hypothetically speaking, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
If I said, "Okay, I've learned to trust 
you now"—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: So, what happens then?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Your role here is done, bye-bye." ...Is 
that how it's gonna be?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“Still, if it gave her confidence, then 
isn't that a good thing?”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Just as I was about to say that, Narita 
Taishin spoke up first.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Fine. Don't say it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I won't ask right now. ...I don't want to 
hear it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sorry, I'm going home.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin hurried off as if running 
away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The aftertaste of her dry curry lingered 
with a somewhat bittersweet note.
